correctness.rationale: The source formulas were reconstructed with the exact dispersion and dimensions. Writing the singular Green kernel only through finite differences avoids assigning a value to its divergent constant. The identities \(R_j(x)=[a(x-e_j)-a(x+e_j)]/(4i)\) and \(Q(x)=-[a(x+e_1)+a(x-e_1)-a(x+e_2)-a(x-e_2)]/4\) follow exactly from Fourier shifts. Applying the published square-lattice potential-kernel expansion gives the displayed coefficients; the order-\(r^{-2}\) angular correction contributes only \(O(r^{-3})\) to \(R_j\) and \(O(r^{-4})\) to \(Q\). No finite experiment is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The spatial decay exponent and angular leading tensor are natural invariants of a threshold state: they distinguish the non-square-integrable odd resonance from the square-integrable even threshold mode, expose their nodal geometry, and determine the leading long-range profile relevant to truncation and interaction of localized defects. The result is therefore a structural localization statement, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a numerical recomputation.
